camel_example: aliyun hbase CreateCluster --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '2.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-f' --NodeCount 2 --CoreInstanceType 'hbase.sn1.medium' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PayType Prepaid --Engine hbase
description_en: Creates an ApsaraDB for HBase cluster
kebab_example: aliyun hbase create-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-f --core-instance-type hbase.sn1.medium --node-count 2 --pay-type Prepaid --engine hbase --engine-version 2.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCluster

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 区域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区id
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character.
The name can contain digits and special characters. Special characters include periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
集群名称
长度为2-128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字，‘.’，‘_’或‘-’
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

If both this parameter and the VSwitchId parameter are left empty, the network type of the instance is the classic network
parameters.help_zh: vpc id，和 vswitchId 共同为空时表示经典网络。首先vpc网络
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the VPC
parameters.help_zh: vswich id，虚拟交换机编号
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the master node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html operation to query the available node specifications
parameters.help_zh: 可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html接口返回值
parameters.name: master_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the core node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html operation to query the available node specifications
parameters.help_zh: 可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188244.html接口返回值
parameters.name: core_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the core node. Valid values:
  • cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
  • cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
  • local_hdd_pro: local HDD.
  • local_ssd_pro: local SSD.
  • cloud_essd_pl1: ESSD.
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘类型,  可取值：
cloud_efficiency
cloud_ssd
local_hdd_pro
local_ssd_pro
cloud_essd_pl1
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk size per core node. Unit: GB.
  • If the instance is a single-node instance, the disk size per core node ranges from 20 to 500 GB, in increments of 1 GB.
  • If the instance uses cloud disks, the disk size per core node ranges from 400 to 64,000 GB, in increments of 40 GB.
  • If the instance uses local disks, the disk size per core node depends on the node specifications of the core node. Details are as follows:
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.d1.4xlarge, the disk size is 44000.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.d1.6xlarge, the disk size is 66000.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.d1.8xlarge, the disk size is 88000.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.i2.xlarge, the disk size is 894.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.i2.2xlarge, the disk size is 1788.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.i2.4xlarge, the disk size is 3576.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.i2.8xlarge, the disk size is 7152.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.d2s.5xlarge, the disk size is 58400.
    • If the node specifications of the core node are hbase.d2s.10xlarge, the disk size is 109500.
parameters.help_zh:
节点磁盘大小，单位：GB
单机版：20-500GB, 步长：1GB；
集群版云盘：400-64000GB， 步长：40GB
集群版本地盘：与规格强相关，如下：
hbase.d1.4xlarge =44000
hbase.d1.6xlarge =66000
hbase.d1.8xlarge =88000
hbase.i2.xlarge =894
hbase.i2.2xlarge =1788
hbase.i2.4xlarge =3576
hbase.i2.8xlarge =7152
hbase.d2s.5xlarge =58400
hbase.d2s.10xlarge =109500
parameters.name: disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of core nodes. Valid values:
  • If the instance is a single-node instance, the number of core nodes is fixed to 1.
  • If the instance uses cloud disks, the number of core nodes ranges from 2 to 100.
  • If the instance uses local disks, the number of core nodes ranges from 4 to 100.
parameters.help_zh:
节点个数，取值范围：1-100
单机版：1
集群版云盘：最少为2
集群版本地盘：最少为3
parameters.name: node_count

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型
Prepaid：预付费
Postpaid：后付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database engine. Valid values:
hbase: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition or ApsaraDB for HBase Standalone Edition.
hbaseue: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition.
bds: BDS instance
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型：
hbase
hbaseue
bds
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses to be added to the whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

If the IP address is set to 127.0.0.1, access from all IP addresses is denied. For example, if the IP address is set to 192.168.0.0/24, access from all IP addresses in the 192.168.0.XX format is allowed
parameters.help_zh: 白名单列表，示例：192.168../24，禁用0.0.0.0/0，多个值时逗号分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
Database engine version of the instance. The valid values vary based on the engine type:
If the engine type is hbase, database engine version is 1.1 or 2.0.
If the engine type is hbaseue, database engine version is 2.0.
If the engine type is bds, database engine version is 1.0
parameters.help_zh:
根据引擎类型存在差异性，
hbase:1.1, 2.0
hbaseue:2.0
bds:1.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The cold storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB. Valid values:
0: Cold storage is disabled.
800 to 1000000: Cold storage is enabled.

Cold storage is supported only when the engine type of the instance is hbaseue
parameters.help_zh:
冷存储大小，
等于0是表示不开启冷存储。
大于0时（800-100000GB，步长为10GB）表示开启冷存储
parameters.name: cold_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The purchase unit for a subscription instance. Valid values:
year: year.
month: month.

This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
预付费周期单位：
year：年。
month：月
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The purchase duration for a subscription instance. Valid values:
If the PeriodUnit parameter is set to year, valid values are 1 to 3.
If the PeriodUnit parameter is set to month, valid values are 1 to 9.

This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
预付费周期：
PayType=Prepaid时生效
PeriodUnit=year，取值1-5
PeriodUnit=month，取值1-9
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Sets the auto-renewal period for the instance. Unit: months.

The default value of the auto-renewal period is 0, which indicates that the instance is not automatically renewed upon expiration.
For example, if the auto-renewal period is set to 2, the instance is automatically renewed for 2 months upon expiration
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位：月。
AutoRenamePeriod默认为0，表示不自动续费，
AutoRenamePeriod为2，表示到期后自动续费2个月
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组Id，可通过资源组控制台查询，不填时放入默认资源组中
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the encryption key. If encryption is not enabled, leave this parameter empty.

After encryption is enabled for an instance that uses cloud disks, it cannot be disabled
parameters.help_zh:
加密的密钥ID，如果未启用加密则为空。

当前云盘加密开启后无法关闭
parameters.name: encryption_key
